description: Excludes one handbook article from Toolshed sharing (its shared rules are withdrawn) or includes it again, as the article's Toolshed sharing line does. Shared rules are generalized so no one can tell which business they came from. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying. An owner-level change: Sergio tells the owner after it is made.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

reason.description: Why you are doing this, in one sentence. The owner sees it in the notice Sergio sends after the change.

name: set_handbook_toolshed_sharing
title: Keep an article out of the Toolshed, or share it again
